name: SL-M770-A control pair
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed 255 g for the complete left/right SL-M770-A band-clamp control pair, for 3×9-speed shifting with removable optical gear displays. The table explicitly states g/pair; the repeated pair figure is not doubled. Cable/housing inclusion is not specified. The A revision remains distinct from SL-M770.
